hero.title: Meel Ammaan ah oo Haween kasta
hero.subtitle: Netsanet waa madal AI-ku shaqeeyo oo ah warbixin dacwadeed sir ah, hagitaanka sharciga iyo taageerada dadka dhibaataysan — oo ku helaya luqaddaada.

features.title: Badbaadada loo dhisay, Kalsooni loo naqshadeeyay
features.subtitle: Sifooyin kasta waxaa loo sameeyay inay xoojiyaan dadka dhibaataysan iyo hay'adaha u adeega.

items.title: Warbixin Sir ah
items.description: Dacwadaha u soo gudbi si qarsoodi ah ama aqoonsigaaga — ammaankaagu waa marka hore.

items.title: AI Kala-soocida
items.description: Nidaamkayaga caqliga lahu dacwadaha degdegga ah mudnaanta siiyaa.

items.title: Kaydka Caddaynta
items.description: Sawirro, codad iyo dukumentiyada ku kaydi bakhaarka sir ahaaneed.

items.title: Hagitaanka Sharciga AI
items.description: Macluumaad sharci oo degdeg ah ku hel Amxaarik, Tigrinya, Oromiffa iwm.

items.title: Fariimo Toos ah
items.description: Si toos ah kala xiriir shaqaalaha dacwaddaada kanaalka sirta ah.

items.title: Shabakadda Hay'adaha
items.description: Dacwadaha waxaa lagu wareejiyaa MoWSA, EWLA, hoyga iyo bukaan-socod.

howItWorks.title: Saddex Tallaabo Fudud
howItWorks.subtitle: Warbixinta ilaa xalka — tallaabo kasta waan kula soconnaa.

steps.title: Warbixin
steps.description: Dacwaddaada si ammaan ah u soo gudbi foomka hagaha.

steps.title: Isu ekeysi
steps.description: AI dacwaddaada baaraysa oo kula xiriirinaysa hay'adda saxda ah.

steps.title: Taageero hel
steps.description: Dacwaddaada raac, shaqaalaha la xiriir — dhammaanteed hal meel.

cta.title: Diyaar ma u tahay Tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya?
cta.subtitle: Safar kasta wuxuu ku bilowdaa geesinimo. Netsanet ayaa diyaar u ah inay ku taageeraan.
cta.note: Erayga sirta ah looma baahna. Koodhka hal-mar loo isticmaalo ee emailkaaga loo soo diro ayaa la isticmaalaa.

footer.tagline: Taageerada AI ee haweenka Itoobiya oo dhan.
